message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: a person (defendant) fabricated a document (a false official document) to hide a prior bribery record of a colleague, to meet tender requirements. He printed a fake "检察机关行贿犯罪档案查询结果告知函", altered dates, removed record, and forged the official seal (by copying). This is forging a state document, i.e., forging, altering, or using false official documents. The crime likely is "伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪" (forgery of official documents). Also possibly "行贿" but he is not giving bribe; he is forging documents to hide bribery. So the appropriate charge: "伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪" (forgery of official documents). In examples, they used "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". So answer: 伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章. Possibly also "提供虚假材料" but main is forgery. So single charge.

Thus output: [罪名]伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章<eoa>
